out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: Three of the four handwashing sinks at the back working area are not provided hot water with a minimum temperature of 100F. The hot water at the 3- compartment sink was also noted to be only 88F, below the minimum required temperature of 110F, for such a sink.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. The hot water at the 3-compartment sink is required to be 110F or higher. Provide hot water at proper temperature at all sinks.

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 165F
violations.observation: The water temperature in the manifold servicing the high temperature warewashing machine was below the minimum allowable level of 165F for a stationary rack single temperature machine. The thermostat read @150F. The Wash temperature was observed to be openly 138F, below The minimum temperature of 160F allowed by the data plate.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanical operation the temperature of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 194F or less than 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine or for all other machines, 180F.

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Sanitization Pressure
violations.observation: The pressure gauge for the high temperature warewashing machine was below above 30 PSI. Observed pressure was 135PSI.
violations.corrective_action: The flow pressure of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse in a warewashing machine shall be within the range specified on the machine manufacturer's data plate and may not be less than 5 PSI or more than 30 PSI as measured in the water line immediately downstream or upstream from the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse control valve.
